_note: Carts on the street map (systems/carts.js rules; world/innerMap/carts.js the ground they take; ui/innerMapCarts.js spawns, drives, draws and lets the player use them). A cart is a train behind whoever leads it: the puller (or the merchant at the horse's head) on the front tile, the cart's body on the tile(s) behind (kinds.length). A parked cart is solid (paths go round it); a moving one is waited for; a cart never steps onto anyone and never goes indoors (gateways yes).
_art: Sprites made with PixelLab's object creator (8 sides, 4 used): one sheet per kind, a column per facing (up, left, down, right: the game's facing order) and a row per variant. cell: the source cell in px. scale: drawn size of a cell in tiles (a standing person is about 1 x 1.8 tiles). lead: how far the sprite's middle sits from the body's tile toward the one leading it, in tiles. lift: drawn this many tiles up from the tile's middle.
_kinds: length: tiles the cart's body (and a wagon's horse) take behind the one leading it. speed: share of the leader's walk. good: the market good a player's cart is (in the pack: a handcart of their own on every street map they walk).
_push: The player hauling a cart: share of their own walk (base, + perStrength a point of strength over 5, at most max; laden: x this with someone or goods on it).
_use: Using a cart that isn't yours (any cart standing with no one at it) is theft of its use: seen by anyone within seenWithin tiles, it is a petty theft (underworld 'theft' x crimeScale, the owner's opinion of you down by disposition) and they shout. A cart someone is pulling is never free to take.
_carters: Mornings (hours) the town's carters (job carter, else a labourer or a farmer) push handcarts loaded with goods between the stores (from, to: building types), at most max at once on the map, one start every gapSecs at the most. Not in a village with fewer than minStores stores. parked: handcarts left standing by the stores (owned by the town, free for anyone to take — theft of use), at most parkedMax.
_plague: A plague in town (Illness: a plague sickness at epidemic, or plague doors marked): in its hours a death cart goes house to house to the marked doors, its crier calling; at each door it stops stopSecs; bodies (the town's dead these last bodyDays days, at most maxBodies) are loaded at the doors; then to the churchyard's gate, else a plague pit outside the nearest gate. At most once a day.

cry: Bring out your dead! Bring out your dead!
The cart is here! Bring out your dead!
pit: Into the pit with them. God forgive us.
No priest for these, poor souls.

_caravan: A merchant caravan leaving the town the player is in today (systems/merchantCaravans.js, its trade_caravan from this town): in its hours its wagon is loaded at the market (loadSecs, porters carrying sacks to it), then rolls out by the nearest gate and is gone. At most one at a time.

leave: Off we go — {to} by nightfall, God willing!
Open the gate! Wagon coming through!
